_comment: PRODUCTION TEMPLATE - committed on purpose so the deploy host always has
the right shape. NEVER put a real password or JWT secret in this file:
this repository is PUBLIC. Supply the real values as environment
variables on the host (these override anything set here):
ConnectionStrings__Default = full SQL Server connection string
The app validates Jwt:Key at startup and refuses to boot if it is
missing or shorter than 32 characters, so a misconfigured deploy fails
loudly instead of silently issuing forgeable tokens.
Add EXTRA CORS origins as Cors__Origins__1, Cors__Origins__2, ...
